signature.name: VTask.mkContinuousOfExistsBound
signature.type: {𝕜 : Type u_1} -> {𝕜₂ : Type u_2} -> {E : Type u_3} -> {F : Type u_4} -> [Ring 𝕜] -> [Ring 𝕜₂] -> [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] -> [SeminormedAddCommGroup F] -> [Module 𝕜 E] -> [Module 𝕜₂ F] -> {σ : 𝕜 →+* 𝕜₂} -> (f : E →ₛₗ[σ] F) -> (h : ∃ C, ∀ (x : E), ‖f x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖) -> E →SL[σ] F

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: This is a total constructor with no junk-value conventions; it is well-defined for all inputs satisfying the stated types.

facts.statement: ∀ {𝕜 : Type*} {𝕜₂ : Type*} {E : Type*} {F : Type*} [Ring 𝕜] [Ring 𝕜₂] [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [SeminormedAddCommGroup F] [Module 𝕜 E] [Module 𝕜₂ F] {σ : 𝕜 →+* 𝕜₂} (f : E →ₛₗ[σ] F) (h : ∃ C, ∀ x : E, ‖f x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖), Continuous (VTask.mkContinuousOfExistsBound f h)
